_note: Real city pairs and their airlines around the Agadir CTA, imported by tools/import_flight_pairs.py from tools/traffic/Agadir_CTA_Flight_Plan_Routes.xlsx. The generator draws a flight's departure, destination and airline from these pairs when the flow it flies serves them (the flows keep the RAD routes; the workbook's own routes are not flown). gmac_sectors / gmac_dist_nm: measured on the workbook route against the simulator's sectors (nearby when within 120 NM). codes: the airline's group codes and their shares. no_service: pairs not flown (never generated).
